title: AccessLogLine
description: One line of a restricted-access log (E4, B37/D23; closes B30(c)'s P9 marker in engine/kb/provenance.py). The anti-leakage boundary's evidence trail (S8): every attempt — granted or denied, human or machine — leaves a line BEFORE authorization decides. A separate file from the run log by decision: provenance access is a security record, not pipeline telemetry. B14's richer file shape (sources list, identifiers map) lives on the provenance records; this schema covers only the log line.

ts.description: Real wall-clock UTC — this is a security log, deliberately outside the byte-determinism regime (timestamped files are excluded, tests/kb/test_seed_store.py).

actor.description: Who attempted the access — a human name from the identity seam, or 'engine' for machine paths.

purpose.description: The closed purpose vocabulary — a purpose any caller can invent is a comment, not a control (S8).

action.description: What was attempted on the restricted store.

kb_id.description: The card whose provenance was touched (read/delete).

client.description: purge sweep: the client the sweep verified removed.

clean.description: purge sweep verdict — the evidence the purge honored the client commitment.
